subject: Counting glitch impacting April invoices — next steps & timeline
content:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Pauline Kim <pauline.kim@bluenova.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 01 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Counting glitch impacting April invoices — next steps & timeline

Hi Pauline —

Quick note to let you know we identified an issue that caused duplicate token counts for a subset of requests processed between 2026-04-27 02:00 UTC and 2026-04-29 18:30 UTC. That window affects part of BlueNova's April invoice.

What we saw: an internal retry path in our batching layer replayed several short requests when a cache write raced with the request completion path. The result was the same customer calls being counted twice in our metering layer.

What we’re proposing:
- We will issue a corrective credit equivalent to the duplicated token charges (estimated at $3,820).
- Adjust the April invoice to reflect the credit; provisional credit applied within 72 hours, final line-item adjustment by the next billing cycle after your approval.
- We’ve attached a CSV that lists impacted request timestamps and the provisional credit math for your review.

Next steps from us:
1) Engineering will run a full recount and produce a signed incident summary (ETA: Monday 2026-05-03 EOD PT).
2) Finance will post a provisional credit to your account within 72 hours.
3) If that works for you, we’ll apply the final adjustment and send an adjusted invoice + DocuSign amendment link.

Pauline — do you want us to apply the provisional credit automatically or route this through your AP for signoff first?

Apologies for the noise here — we know this is disruptive. I’ll follow up with the postmortem and formal adjustment once the recount completes.

— Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183

Attachment: billing_adjustment_04292026.csv (CSV, 14KB)

---

From: Pauline Kim <pauline.kim@bluenova.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 May 2026 10:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Counting glitch impacting April invoices — next steps & timeline

Thanks Alex —

Appreciate the heads-up. Can you confirm the final dollar impact after the recount? Our AP needs a line-item reference to accept any automatic adjustment. If the provisional credit is applied, please CC accounts-payable@bluenova.com and include a short note they can attach to their ERP.

Also: will this affect our committed credits or overage thresholds for May? We’re prepping an internal forecast and need any changes surfaced.

— Pauline
Director of Data Products, BlueNova Analytics
pauline.kim@bluenova.com | +1 (617) 555-2234

---

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Pauline Kim <pauline.kim@bluenova.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, accounts-payable@bluenova.com
Date: Sat, 02 May 2026 08:47:55 -0700
Subject: Re: Counting glitch impacting April invoices — next steps & timeline

Hi Pauline —

Thanks for the quick reply — and great question about May thresholds. Short answers:
- Final dollar impact: initial engineering recount narrows the duplication to 1,276 requests = provisional credit $3,820.12. We will publish a reconciled CSV with the exact per-line counts in the incident summary.
- Committed credits/thresholds for May: No changes to your contracted thresholds. This is a retrospective correction and will not affect the May usage buckets.

Attached is an interim incident summary (redacted) that explains the root cause and the fix we deployed (hotfix on 2026-04-29 18:35 UTC to prevent the retry race). Final signed postmortem will include mitigation timelines and a permanent guard against this replay class.

We’ll apply the provisional credit Monday morning and copy your AP with the ERP-friendly memo. Please reply if you’d prefer routing via your procurement contact instead.

— Alex

Attachment: incident-summary-0429.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 03 May 2026 11:16:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Counting glitch impacting April invoices — next steps & timeline

Alex —

Finance confirms provisional credit creation workflow. I’ve authorized a $3,820.12 provisional credit against BlueNova (deal DN-7345). AP memo draft is attached; please include it when you CC their accounts-payable address. Once BlueNova acknowledges, we’ll push final adjustment and mark the ticket JIRA-INFR-8721 as resolved.

Also, for the internal record: engineering says the fix is already in prod and we have an automated replay detection rule being added to the metering pipeline this quarter.

— Marissa
Director, Customer Success Finance Operations
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Subject: Final: provisional credit applied + adjusted invoice follow-up

Hi Pauline / BlueNova AP —

This is to confirm the provisional credit of $3,820.12 has been posted to your account (ref: DN-7345 provisional credit 2026-05-04). We also uploaded the reconciliation CSV and the incident summary to the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD-example-adjustment-doc

Next items:
- If you’re comfortable with the provisional credit, we’ll issue the final adjusted invoice and DocuSign amendment (link will come from finance@redwood.ai).
- If AP needs a formal amendment signed first, let me know and I’ll route the DocuSign immediately.

Thank you again for your patience. We understand the disruption this causes for month-end closes and are standing by to coordinate with your AP team directly.

Best,
